business_problem: categorize large volumes of ecommerce products accurately across retailer taxonomies without waiting on scarce data-science capacity or month-long delivery cycles.
solution_summary: Skai uses Snowflake, Cortex AI, and Snowpark on Snowflake to categorize large volumes of ecommerce products accurately across retailer taxonomies without waiting on scarce data-science capacity or month-long delivery cycles. Product, category, and marketplace data are centralized in Snowflake so marketing and client-delivery teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Cortex AI adds in-platform LLM and agentic capabilities for classification, summarization, retrieval, or natural-language analytics on top of the curated data foundation. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Skai achieved 2 Days to deploy to production instead of a month and 100k Products categorized in just 30 days.
